hero.title: Integrating Technology, Inspiring Learners.
paragraphs: As an EdTech Coach and QTS-qualified Computer Science Teacher at the British International School Hanoi, I work at the intersection of strategic technology leadership and classroom practice. As a Microsoft Innovative Educator Expert, I teach IBDP and IGCSE Computer Science while leading data-driven EdTech strategy development across the school. My dual role encompasses strategic planning, change management, and designing impactful professional development that drives meaningful technology integration to enhance student outcomes. I've led comprehensive EdTech audits, developed AI policies, and delivered targeted professional development programs that achieved 95% positive staff feedback while improving digital competency across the school.

With experience spanning software development, digital humanities, and international teaching, I bring a practical lens to technology integration - understanding both technical possibilities and classroom realities. As a Computer Science teacher delivering IBDP and IGCSE curriculum, I've achieved consistently strong academic outcomes while pioneering innovative programs like the Student Tech Ambassador initiative and implementing strategic processes that deliver measurable impact.
